IS : 8254 (Part II )-1976 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
VALVE, NON-REBREATHING 

PART II AMBU-HESSE'S PATTERN 



( Reaffirmed 1998) 



1, Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for Ambu-Hesse's pattern valve used for prevent- 
ing rebreathing during ventilation of lungs and for equipment for resuscitation. 

2!. Material 

2.1 Plastics Parts — The plastics parts shall be sturdy, nonbreakable, clean, transparent and free 
from scratches. They shall be resistant to anaesthetic vapours and gases. They shall withstand 
the normal steam or chemical sterilization. 

2.2 Rubber Parts- The rubber parts shall be made of good quality natural, antistatic rubber. The 
rubber shall be resistant to anaesthetic vapours and gases. It shall withstand ageing in an air-oven 
tor 168 hours at 70 ± 1 °C without showing appreciable stiffening, softening, cracking or other 
ciiange in condition. It shall have a minimum tensile strength ^of lOMN/m^ before and after ageing 
and a minimum elongation at break of 500 percent before ageing and 400 percent after ageing. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 




EXPIRATION 



OUTLET TO 
PATIENT END 

All dimensions in millimetres. 

FIG. 1 VALVE, AMBU-HESSE'S PATTERN 

3.1 The dead space (space between the seat of the valve and the patient connector) shall not b( 
more than 17 mm. 

3.2 A deviation of ± 2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 
4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The valve shall be designed to prevent rebreathing by ensuring unidirectional flow of all expiree 
gases.

IS : 8254 (Part II ) -1976 

4.2 The valve shall not stick at any stage. 

4.3 All the surfaces of the valve shall be smooth and free from pinholes, wrinkles, creases, embedded 
foreign matter and other defects. 

4.4 The inlet and outlet to patient end connections shall be suitable for conical fittings of adult 
and paediatric sizes conforming to IS: 7409-1974 'Specification for breathing attachments for 
anaesthetic apparatus '. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Performance- The valve shall be tested for inspiration and expiration pressures. The 
resistance to flow at 25 l/min shall not be more than 78 N/m^ ( approximately 0'8 cm of water) during 
inspiration and 98 N/m^ ( approximately 1'0 cm of water) during expiration. 

5.2 The functioning of the valve shall remain unimpaired when the valve is operated at a frequency 
of 40 respirations per minute. 

5.3 Non-return Action 

5.3.1 The closing of the valve for inspiratory action shall not require a flow of air more 
tt an 35 1/min from the in^et side. 

5.3.2 The leakage through the valve, when the valve is closed in either direction under a gas 
pressure of 1'96 kN/m^ (approximately 20 cm of water ), shall not be more than 400 ml/min. 

6. Marking —The valve shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade- 
mark; and an arrow mark on the body to indicate the direction of flow of gas. 

6.1 ISI Certification f\/larking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer.
